steps.u: Write a Prometheus alert for when the queue depth of our email-sender stays above 5000 for 10 minutes, and wire a runbook link to it.

steps.r:
groups:
- name: queues
  rules:
  - record: queue:depth:max5m
    expr: max_over_time(queue_depth{service="email-sender"}[5m])

i.new_string:
expr: max_over_time(queue_depth{service="email-sender"}[5m])
  - alert: EmailQueueBacklog
    expr: queue_depth{service="email-sender"} > 5000
    for: 10m
    labels: { severity: page }
    annotations:
      summary: Email queue above 5000 for 10 minutes
      runbook_url: https://wiki.example.test/runbooks/email-queue-backlog

steps.a: The alert fires on the raw gauge with for: 10m rather than the existing 5-minute max recording rule, because the max would hold the alert on for 5 extra minutes after recovery. The runbook page itself does not exist yet, so the link will 404.

reference.summary: Added a Prometheus alert for the email-sender queue staying above 5000 for 10 minutes, with severity page and a runbook link; promtool validation and the existing rule tests pass. The runbook page it links to does not exist yet.
facts: uses the raw gauge, not the 5 minute max recording rule

decisions.choice: alert on the raw queue depth instead of the existing max over 5 minutes recording rule
decisions.reason: the max would keep the alert firing for 5 extra minutes after the queue recovered
